Package org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr

Class Datum

java.lang.Object
org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr.Datum
Direct Known Subclasses:
Atom, Cons, Nil
public abstract sealed class Datum extends Object permits Atom, Cons, Nil
Basic unit of an S-expression. A datum is either an Atom, a Cons, or Nil.

Note that Nil is both an atom (to be distinguished from the Atom class, which is exclusively atoms with a value) and a list.

Datums must implement hashCode() and equals(Object) in a way such that they are compared by value, not by object identity. Datums should implement a reasonably descriptive string representation by overriding Object.toString(), though this is not mandatory.

    • isList

      public static boolean isList(Datum node)
      Returns whether the datum is a list. A list is either a cons cell or nil. A non-nil atom is not considered a list, despite DatumList treating it as an empty list with itself as the improper terminator.

      This is a basic type check and does not check that the terminator is nil. To validate a proper list, use isProperList(Datum) or asProperList(Datum) if you need to access its elements.

      Parameters:
      node - the datum
      Returns:
      whether the datum is a list
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - on null node

    • asList

      public static DatumList asList(Datum node)
      Returns the datum as a list. The returned view conforms to the interface List<Datum>.

      Note this view is even more permissive than isList(Datum), treating non-nil atoms as empty lists with itself as the improper terminator. If this seems unacceptable, chain this call with .requireProperTail() or use asProperList(Datum).

      Parameters:
      node - the datum
      Returns:
      a view as a list
      Since:
      0.1.0

    • ofDeque

      public static Datum ofDeque(Deque<? extends Datum> q)
      Constructs a proper list from a Deque. Elements are popped from the front and prepended one at a time, reversing their iteration order. This drains the deque and is thus destructive!
      Parameters:
      q - the deque
      Returns:
      a copy of the deque as a datum
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if q or any deque element is null
      Since:
      0.1.0

    • asAlist

      public static AssocList asAlist(Datum node)
      Returns the datum as an associative list (alist). The returned view conforms to the interface Map<Datum,Datum>. On top of being a proper list with a nil-terminator, each element must be a cons whose car is the key and whose cdr is the value. First car-key wins.
      Parameters:
      node - datum
      Returns:
      the datum as an alist
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the list is not a proper list, or the list consists of any non-cons datum
      NullPointerException - if node is null
      Since:
      0.1.0
